notes.text: eunuchs. Eunuchs were emasculated men who served in the courts of kings as officials and as guardians of the harem. Hezekiah's descendants, specifically Jehoiakim's family and other Judean princes, were forced to serve in the courts of the kings of Babylon (Dan. 1:1-6).

quotes.text: thou shalt bring forth children ; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and ho shall rule over thee .” — Gen iii. 16.
